c74object.name: el.phasemod~
c74object.description:
el.phasemod~ is an oscillator that uses phase distortion synthesis to generate dynamic harmonic spectra. An internal linear phase ramp is nonlinearly warped using an exponential curve controlled by a slope factor (alpha) before reading from a sine wavetable (conceptually similar to the phase distortion synthesis used in Casio CZ instruments or MSP's kink~). Both frequency and the alpha distortion factor can be adjusted with control messages or modulated continuously at audio rate.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / float / messages): Fundamental frequency in Hertz, and control message inlet (mute).
Inlet 2 [Right Inlet] (signal / float): Slope factor (Alpha). Controls the degree and curvature of exponential phase distortion.
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Phase-distorted oscillator audio output.

inlet.description: Sets the fundamental oscillator frequency in Hertz. Also accepts the mute command.
Sets the phase distortion slope factor (alpha). Accepts float values or audio-rate modulation signals.

objarg.name: frequency
objarg.description: Initial fundamental frequency in Hertz (default: 440.0 Hz).

method.name: float
method.description: Float sent to inlet 1 sets fundamental frequency in Hertz. Float sent to inlet 2 sets the alpha slope factor.

method.name: int
method.description: Converted to float to set frequency (inlet 1) or the alpha slope factor (inlet 2).

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence. When set to 0 (default), normal synthesis resumes.

method.name: signal
method.digest: Audio-rate frequency or phase slope modulation
method.description: Signal arriving at inlet 1 controls frequency in Hertz. Signal arriving at inlet 2 modulates the alpha distortion curvature continuously at audio rate.
